name: Trace
description: A workflow automation platform that routes tasks to the right agent – human or AI. By connecting tools like Slack, Jira and Notion – Trace breaks down existing workflows, spots automation opportunities and embeds AI agents to repetitive tasks.
label: Workflow Automations for the Human 👾 AI Workforce
label_zh: 工作流自动化，为人类 👾 AI 团队赋能
content_zh: Trace 是一个工作流自动化平台，能够将任务分配给合适的执行者——无论是人类还是AI。通过连接Slack、Jira和Notion等工具，Trace可以拆解现有的工作流程，发现自动化的可能性，并将AI代理嵌入到重复性任务中。

name: Qoder
description: Qoder transforms how AI understands real software. Beyond snippets, it grasps your entire architecture—dependencies, patterns, history. Chat naturally for multi-file edits or delegate tasks to AI. From invisible complexity to transparent collaboration.
label: Qoder is an agentic IDE for real software development.
label_zh:
Qoder 是一个用于实际软件开发的代理集成开发环境。 

---

根据直译的结果重新意译，让内容更通俗易懂：

Qoder 是一款专为实际软件开发设计的智能集成开发环境。
content_zh: Qoder 改变了 AI 理解真实软件的方式。它不仅能理解代码片段，还能全面掌握你的整个架构——包括依赖关系、模式和历史记录。你可以自然地与 AI 交流，进行多文件编辑，或将任务委托给 AI。从隐藏的复杂性到透明的协作，一切变得简单明了。

name: Onlook
description: Onlook is the first-ever developer tool for designers.
label: The open-source, Cursor for Designers
content_zh: Onlook 是首个专为设计师打造的开发工具。

name: TraceRoot.AI
description: Traceroot is an AI-native, open-source observability tool that connects logs, traces, metrics, code, and team discussions. It doesn’t just summarize issues — it helps fix them by creating GitHub issues and PRs in a developer-friendly workflow.
label: Fix bugs faster with open source, AI native observability
label_zh: 修复 bug 更快，使用开源、AI 原生可观测性
content_zh: TraceRoot.AI 是一个基于 AI 的开源可观测性工具，能够连接日志、追踪数据、指标、代码和团队讨论。它不仅总结问题，还能通过创建 GitHub 问题和拉取请求，以开发者友好的方式帮助解决问题。

name: Vercel
description: Vercel provides the developer tools and cloud infrastructure to build, scale, and secure a faster, more personalized web.
label: The frontend cloud. Creators of Next.js.
content_zh: Vercel 提供开发工具和云基础设施，帮助你构建、扩展和保护更快、更个性化的网站。

name: With a View
description: Discover bars, restaurants and cafes with stunning views.
label: Beautiful stories begin with a view
label_zh: 美丽的故事，从一个视角开始
content_zh: 发现拥有绝美风景的酒吧、餐厅和咖啡馆。

name: Re:Connect
description: Revolutionary webcam-based eye-tracking technology that turns any laptop into a powerful text dictation tool. No expensive hardware required.
label: Speak with Your Eyes No Special Hardware Needed
label_zh: 用眼神交流，无需特殊硬件
topics_zh:
技术 

根据直译结果重新意译，保持原有格式不变：

摄像头
content_zh: 革命性的基于网络摄像头的眼球追踪技术，可以将任何笔记本电脑变成强大的语音输入工具。无需昂贵的硬件设备。

name: Revyu.AI - Smart Hotel Booking
description: Stop endless scrolling: Text search with AI - get personalized results list - see real analysis - Book with Confidence! With Revyu.AI Chrome extension you can search with simple text, summarize hotel reviews and get answers to your questions. Get it for free!
label: Find, review and book hotels like you own them!
label_zh: 查找、评价并预订酒店，就像它们是您的一样！
content_zh: 停止无尽滚动：使用AI进行文本搜索 - 获取个性化结果列表 - 查看真实分析 - 信心满满地预订！通过Revyu.AI的Chrome扩展程序，你可以用简单的文字进行搜索，汇总酒店评价，并获得问题的答案。免费获取！

name: Walk the World
description: Have you walked enough this week to finish the Boston marathon? Find out with Walk the World, an addictively healthy new take on step-tracking. It converts your daily steps into iconic map milestones, with souvenirs to collect along the way.
label: Transform your daily steps into satisfying map milestones
label_zh: 将每日步数转化为令人满意的地图里程碑
content_zh: 你这周走的步数够完成波士顿马拉松了吗？用Walk the World来查一查吧。这款应用以一种令人上瘾且健康的方式记录你的步数，将你的每日步数转换成地图上的著名地标，并让你沿途收集纪念品。

name: Cohere
description: We build high performance, secure language models for the enterprise. Our customizable, high-performance language models work on public, private, or hybrid clouds to ensure data security & exceptional support.
label: Build incredible products with world-class language AI
label_zh: 用世界级的语言AI打造卓越的产品
content_zh: 我们为企业构建高性能且安全的语言模型。我们的可定制、高性能语言模型可以在公有云、私有云或混合云上运行，确保数据安全并提供卓越的支持。

name: MentorCruise
description: Get 1:1 guidance from top experts in Software Engineering, Product Management, AI, Design, and Business – only on MentorCruise.
label: Connect with the world's greatest mentors
content_zh: 在MentorCruise上，你可以获得来自软件工程、产品管理、人工智能、设计和商业等领域顶尖专家的一对一指导。

name: Sprout Track
description: The Beta Launch! Baby tracking that works for your whole family. Track feeding, sleep, diapers & milestones from any browser. Share access instantly with caregivers via ID/PIN - no downloads or accounts required. Built by parents for parents.
label: A web-based baby activity app with seamless family sharing
label_zh: 一款基于网页的宝宝活动应用，支持无缝家庭共享
content_zh: Beta版上线！适用于全家的宝宝追踪工具。通过任何浏览器记录喂养、睡眠、换尿布和成长里程碑。通过ID/PIN即时与看护人共享访问权限，无需下载或注册账号。由父母为父母打造。

name: Rexpt - AI Receptionist Service
description: Rexpt, Smart AI Receptionist to handle all your Business front desk utilizing Artificial Intelligence. Rexpt handles your business calls 24/7, Nurture Leads, Take Calendar Bookings, Fight Spam Calls, Take Notes & Provide Worry-Free Front-Desk Management.
label: Never Miss a Call, Never Miss a Client with Agentic AI App
label_zh: 永不漏接电话，永不失去客户，Agentic AI 应用程序为您保驾护航
content_zh: Rexpt 是一款智能 AI 接待员服务，利用人工智能处理您企业的前台事务。它可以全天候接听业务电话、培育潜在客户、安排日程、屏蔽骚扰电话、记录信息，并提供无忧的前台管理。

name: Hedge UI
description: Launch your trading application fast with Hedge UI, a React starter kit for building high-quality, customisable trading apps.
label: React starter kit for trading applications
label_zh: React 交易应用启动套件
content_zh: 使用Hedge UI快速启动你的交易应用程序，这是一个用于构建高质量、可定制交易应用的React启动工具包。

name: SAS Connect
description: SAS Connect simplifies workforce management with automated rostering, real-time tracking, and advanced reporting built to scale from smart tools to full ERP for precision-driven industries.
label: The digital core of construction
content_zh: SAS Connect 通过自动化排班、实时跟踪和高级报告功能，简化了劳动力管理。它能够从智能工具扩展到全面的ERP系统，适用于需要精准管理的行业。
